articles.summary: Canopy Growth Corporation (“Canopy Growth”, “our”, “we” or the “Company”) (TSX: WEED) (Nasdaq: CGC), a leading global company committed to bettering lives through cannabis, today announced that its Smiths Falls, Ontario facility (“Smiths Falls”) has received European Union Good Manufacturing Practice (“EU GMP”) certification for manufacturing and packaging activities from the Tübingen Regional Council (Regierungspräsidium Tübingen), Baden-Württemberg’s competent medicines regulatory authority in Germany.
articles.title: Canopy Growth’s Smiths Falls Facility Becomes Canada’s Only EU GMP-certified Site Combining Softgel Manufacturing with Primary Packaging of Softgels, Oral Liquids and Dried Cannabis Flower
